evidence.title: Jiuge-Tuiqiao: An Interpretable Human-AI System for Classical Chinese Poetry Refinement

summary: Researchers have introduced Jiuge‑Tuiqiao, a human‑AI hybrid platform that refines classical Chinese poems while providing transparent, interpretable feedback on each suggested edit. The system combines deep language models with rule‑based linguistic cues, allowing poets to iteratively improve verses while understanding the AI’s reasoning.
title: Interpretable AI System Jiuge‑Tuiqiao Enhances Classical Chinese Poetry Through Human‑AI Collaboration
